_about: MD-11F, from Boeing's MD-11 Airplane Characteristics for Airport Planning (Rev E; the copy on boeing.com's airport planning page) 2.2 General Airplane Dimensions (page index 13): side, plan and front views on one sheet, a picture of about 26 px a meter, stored upside down (layers.py --unrotate --rotate 180). Pixels of layers.py rasters at scale 4, line centres. Scaled by the printed 58.6 m (192 ft 5 in) from the nose to the tail cone. Two engines under the wing and a third on the tail (`tailEngine`): its nacelle runs through the fin's base, on a strut from the crown, with a fairing over its nozzle. The side view draws the tube 1.7% taller than the printed 6.02 m while the plan agrees with it (fit_height.py); the front view draws the fuselage's circle 5% large (its span, engines and nacelles are to the side's scale): crownTop is the circle's centre less the printed radius. The sheet draws the passenger MD-11's windows and doors; the freighter has no windows, and its main-deck cargo door (left) is placed from 2.7.2 (11.6 m to its middle, 3.56 m wide, 2.59 m tall, its sill with the main doors'); the lower-deck cargo doors (right) from 2.7.3's figures (18.03 m and 43.9 m to their middles, 2.64 m and 1.78 m wide, 1.68 m tall; the sheet draws them dashed, 0.7 m and 0.3 m aft of those). Doors 1 and 2 as drawn (2.7.2's elevation draws both on the freighter); the bulk cargo door (left, aft) as drawn. Heights checked against 2.3's ground clearances: the fin's top L, the crown A, the tail engine's top U (each the middle of its range).

windows.note: The MD-11F has no cabin windows. A passenger MD-11 (also MD11) has them: MD11-passenger.

sources.title: Boeing, MD-11 Airplane Characteristics for Airport Planning (Rev E), 2.2 General Airplane Dimensions, 2.3 Ground Clearances, 2.7.2 Cargo Loading Doors - Main Deck (MD-11F/CF), 2.7.3 Cargo Loading Doors, Lower Deck
sources.note: Dimensions and outlines read off the side, plan and front views of 2.2 (tools/trace/md11/); the figures are the aircraft's measurements, not a copy of the drawing. The freighter: no cabin windows; its main-deck cargo door (left) placed from 2.7.2 (11.6 m to its middle, 3.56 m wide, 2.59 m tall, its sill with the main doors'); doors 1 and 2 as drawn (2.7.2's elevation draws both on the freighter; doors 3 and 4 left out); the lower-deck cargo doors (right) from 2.7.3's figures (the sheet draws them 0.7 m and 0.3 m aft of those), the bulk cargo door (left) as drawn. The sheet is a picture of about 26 px a meter and not quite to one scale: scaled by its printed 58.6 m to the tail cone, its overall length, span, engine position and inlet are within 0.8% of their printed figures, but its plan draws the tailplane 4% short of the printed 18.03 m and the wing's root and the wingtip dimension point 0.35 m and 0.9 m ahead of their printed distances (the shape keeps the drawing's), its side view the tube 1.7% taller than the printed 6.02 m (fit to it: fit_height.py) and its front view the fuselage's circle 5% large (tied to the side by the circle's centre). The tail engine (engines[0], mount tail, a straight duct) runs through the fin's base on a strut from the crown, the fin's leading edge standing on its top, a fairing over its nozzle; the fin's tip is 6.24 m above its inlet's top in 2.3's ground clearances (the middles of L and U), as here. The nacelles are the CF6-80C2's the sheet draws.
